[ FAQ ]

A few things you might want to know.

You do not need a finished brief to start a conversation.

01

Can we talk before the brief is ready?

+

Yes. Tell us about your business, what is happening now and what you would like to change. We can help turn that into a clear scope of work.

02

Can we start with just one service?

+

Absolutely. You can bring us a single task — a website, an advertising campaign or an integration — or ask us to connect several areas of work.

03

Do you work with small businesses?

+

Yes. Our focus is small and medium businesses. We shape the scope around the task, your priorities and the stage your business is at.

04

Can you improve an existing website?

+

Yes. We can review your current website and discuss changes to its design, structure, functionality, integrations or promotion.

05

How do you estimate cost and timing?

+

We first agree on the requirements and scope. The estimate depends on the complexity, required functionality, materials available and the services involved.

06

Can the inventory system run on our server?

+

Yes. Our own inventory systems can be installed on a customer’s server. We discuss the infrastructure, workflows and required integrations before implementation.
